verdict.rationale: Graphite documents noise-control levers for its AI reviewer: comment exclusions tell Graphite Agent when not to comment, custom rules steer its reviews, and a dashboard tracks acceptance rates, which lets a lead monitor how useful the comments are. There is no evidence for the other elements of the story. Missing for 10: deduplication of comments, severity labels on comments, any measured or independent evidence of a low false-positive rate, and hands-on corroboration of review signal quality.
